Coram : ARIJIT PASAYAT*, MUKUNDAKAM SHARMA
Service Law - Claim of respondents for entitlement to promotional increments - Directions given by High Court to c consider the claim - Challenged - Held: High Court came to an abrupt conclusion regarding entitlement relying on an earlier decision without indicating as to how the Matter remitted to High Court to decide the matter afresh. D The respondents filed writ petition claiming entitlement to promotional increments on the basis that they were working as J.B.T. teachers and were promoted to the post of Headmaster on the basis on seniority-cum- E merit.
